model_annotation: The plot illustrates the average co-occurrence (ACC) percentage as a function of co-occurrence number for several methods. The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and ranges from 1.0 to 10000, utilizing a logarithmic scale with tick marks spaced by increments of 10, displaying values from 1.0 to 10.0, 10.0 to 100.0, 100.0 to 1000.0, and 1000.0 to 10000. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and extends from 30 to 65, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 5, displaying values from 30 to 35, 40 to 45, 50 to 55, and 60 to 65. A black solid line represents the “Base” method, starting at approximately 35% at Co-occurrence Number 1.0 and increasing to approximately 60% at Co-occurrence Number 10000. A reddish-orange solid line represents the “MEND” method, starting at approximately 40% at Co-occurrence Number 1.0 and increasing to approximately 50% at Co-occurrence Number 10000. A cyan solid line represents the “FT” method, starting at approximately 45% at Co-occurrence Number 1.0 and increasing to approximately 55% at Co-occurrence Number 10000. A green solid line represents the “MEMIT” method, starting at approximately 38% at Co-occurrence Number 1.0 and increasing to approximately 58% at Co-occurrence Number 10000. A red dashed line represents the “IKE” method, starting at approximately 40% at Co-occurrence Number 1.0 and increasing to approximately 50% at Co-occurrence Number 10000. A forest green dashed line represents the “ROME” method, starting at approximately 52% at Co-occurrence Number 1.0 and increasing to approximately 62% at Co-occurrence Number 10000.
